sentences.text: They’re easy points on the exam, because they’re pure numbers.
An oil discharge placard, at least five by eight inches, is required on boats twenty-six feet and over with machinery spaces.
It goes in the machinery space, or at the bilge pump control.
A garbage placard, at least four by nine inches, is also required at twenty-six feet and over.
It goes where your crew and passengers can read it.
And a written waste management plan is required on ocean-going boats of forty feet and over that have a galley and berthing.
It says how garbage is collected, stored and disposed of, and who’s responsible.
So the numbers to keep are twenty-six feet for the two placards, and forty feet for the plan.
